title: qiskit-qudits: A Qiskit Extension for Simulating Qudit Circuits
summary: qiskit-qudits is a Qiskit extension that simulates d-level qudits by encoding each one into m = ceil(log_2 d) qubits. Qudit gates are exposed as ordinary Qiskit Gate and ControlledGate subclasses, and operations that are not unitary gates (measurement, reset, barrier, state preparation) as dedicated Instruction subclasses dispatched through a dedicated apply() hook; every gate carries both a dense encoded unitary (via NumPy's array protocol) and a qubit-level definition.
